# OpenLayers Webmap Tutorial

Welcome to the OpenLayers web mapping tutorial.

This tutorial introduces the basic concepts and workflow for
creating interactive webmaps with OpenLayers.

## Learning objectives

After completing this tutorial, you will be able to:

- create an OpenLayers web map;
- configure a map view;
- add web map layers;
- work with GeoServer WMS services;
- publish a web map using GitHub Pages.
